topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Found a scrap of parchment tucked away in the nooks of our home, my hands trembled a bit as I read the list my partner penned. Each line spoke of dreams nestled deep, places beyond these familiar fields, under skies different from our own. I folded the paper gently, tucking it back where it lay, a secret now shared between the two of us. The world outside is vast, I know, but so is the heart. I’ll find a way to let these dreams grow, perhaps we can see those mountains and seas together. For now, I’ll tend to the land, as I tend to our future, each seed a step closer to horizons yet unseen.
